usage: Use 雞 as a general noun for a chicken; it is a common, everyday word and very neutral in register.
In Cantonese, 雞 is often used in compounds and fixed phrases, especially for food, farm animals, and parts of the bird.
Because it is a countable noun, you normally use a measure word like 一隻雞 when talking about one chicken.
Learners should notice that 雞 can refer to the animal itself, not just cooked chicken, so context matters.
